notes.title: Build 1.005 is Live
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24006732/7835a88863d3a4f69653fe0d535e3d8bc520d494.png[/img]

Hey all,

We have a fix for what was reported this week: 

What in this update?
- The achievement upon completing all others should now correctly be awarded. If you already unlocked all other achievements, this one should be awarded when simply booting the game. 
- A fix for platforms that are reacting to enemies in earlier puzzles in world 6.
- The special achievement for world 5 has been made slightly more forgiving.

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. 

As always, do let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Cheers :)

notes.title: Build 1.003 is Live
notes.content:
Hey all,

Just a quick fix for what was reported earlier today: 

What in this update?
- The 'Help Animation' at the start of world 5 should now be working as intended when playing with the mouse (and keyboard). 

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 


Let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Cheers :)

notes.title: Thanks for all the positive responses to Metrico!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We are very glad so many of you have been exploring the world of Metrico. The responses have been very positive, which is great for the team.

We are also happy with the complete absence of bug reports so far. We will continue to update the build whenever there are things we want to fix. If you do find a bug please send it in, because we want every player to have the best experience possible, and we'd be happy to fix it. 


We just did a quick fix for what was found earlier today: 

1.003 update:
- The 'Help Animation' at the start of world 5 should now be working as intended when playing with the mouse (and keyboard). 

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 


Let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Have fun exploring Metrico!

notes.title: Build 1.002 is Live
notes.content:
Hello fellow explorers!

We´re not really getting any bug reports from you, which is of course a really good sign, but we figured there would have to be some thing that end up going wrong, and now we don't really know what to do ;) 

We did find one thing today that we really wanted to fix asap: 

What in this update?
- A fix concerning the final sequence; The doors may have been open for some players while entering the last section, resulting in an unintended shortcut of the last bit of the experience, and as a result preventing something from being possible that we won't spoil here. 
- Also fixed that the Restart World button in the pauze menu is really only visible when intended.

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 
- Achievements may not appear in your activity feed. We suspect it is because they're all hidden.



Let us know in if you're running into anything! We want to make sure everyone has a nice and smooth experience! 

Cheers :)

notes.title: Welcome to the Metrico+ Steam page!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[h1]WELCOME TO METRICO+![/h1]
We're extremely excited to introduce all of you to the world of Metrico. The Steam page and Steam forum for Metrico+ is now live. Please share the news with everybody and follow Metrico+!

[h1]CLOSED BETA[/h1]
We're having a closed beta right now in which we'd love to get everybody's feedback on the game. (The only way right now to get an invite to the closed beta is when you've played the game at an event where Metrico+ was showcased and got a wristband with an exclusive invite code.)

We're working extremely hard on implementing the last features, adding content and bug-fixing and polishing Metrico+. The release will follow soon after :)

If you have any thoughts, please let us know!


Thanks!
[i][u]Digital Dreams.[/u][/i].
